values.note: Booking site, all 10 sites the same price: $22.99 a night in April-May 2027, $29.99 from mid-June through November (Oct-Nov 2026, Jun-Jul and Oct 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike).

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 'Seneca State Forest Non-electric Campsites' (Inntopia SupplierTile, 2 adults): one night 2027-04-06, 2027-04-13 and 2027-05-11 $22.99; 2026-10-27, 2026-11-10, 2026-11-24, 2027-06-15, 2027-07-13, 2027-10-26 and 2027-07-16/18 $29.99, read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Before occupying any campsite, campers must have a paid reservation and all sites are reservable.' Online, by phone (833-987-2757) or at the campground office. Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday: the booking site refused a one-night Friday (2027-07-16).

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Before occupying any campsite, campers must have a paid reservation and all sites are reservable'; 'Reservations can be for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday – Saturday) or for one night on Sundays through Thursdays'; 'Reservations may be made online or by calling 833-987-2757'; 'Visitors can book a maximum of 14 consecutive nights') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 'Seneca State Forest Non-electric Campsites' (Inntopia SupplierTile, 2 adults) (one-night 2027-07-16: none), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Open from spring through fall, weather permitting' (no dates). The booking site sold nights from 2027-04-06 and through 2026-11-24, none on 2027-03-16 or 2027-12-07.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('The campground is open from spring through fall, weather permitting') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 'Seneca State Forest Non-electric Campsites' (Inntopia SupplierTile, 2 adults), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 'large and secluded' sites with level tent and trailer pads; 'The maximum recommended length for RVs is 28 feet. Contact the forest office regarding larger units and adjacent sites.' The booking site tags sites 6 and 9 pull-through and sites 1, 5 and 6 in its 20-30 ft RV class; site 6 is accessible.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Seneca has 10 large and secluded campsites. The maximum recommended length for RVs is 28 feet') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 'Seneca State Forest Non-electric Campsites' (Inntopia SupplierTile, 2 adults) (unit attribute codes 544 pull-through, 555 20-30 ft, 603 accessible), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free showers and coin-operated laundry at the forest office, not in the campground. Wi-Fi at the forest office; no cell service in the area.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Coin-operated laundry machines and free showers are available at the forest office') + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/ ('Cell service is non-existent in the surrounding area. Wi-Fi is available at the forest office'), read 2026-10-21

note: Small attractive campground fairly high up in the Seneca State Forest. --AWH
summary: WV State Parks camping page + booking site: 10 reservable non-electric sites, RVs to 28 ft recommended (pull-through sites 6 and 9), no hookups; fees changed 29.99 -> 22.99-29.99 (April-May $22.99, summer/fall $29.99); booking now own values (reservation required, 2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max, booking site url); season spring-fall no dates; showers and laundry at the forest office. Not stated: toilets, dump station. Note: dropped AWH's 'Book online via website' (the booking fields say it).
